scope: One instrumented native 2x2 CSS-pixel video candidate over a five-second low-contrast GPU RGB workload, at desktop and compact geometry on one machine. Not natural-video or cross-machine validation.
instrumentation: Temporary copied extension samples four corner RGB values on first/every29th submitted frame, at most120 samples, adding periodic readback overhead. No images retained. Production dist unchanged; timings include fixture instrumentation.

limitations: 170 source/analysis frames were skipped or unavailable.
Effective sampling was below 50 fps; fast flashes may be missed.
Unvalidated candidate engine: no WCAG PASS or NON_CONFORMANT verdict. SDR sRGB is assumed; HDR and colour-management accuracy are not validated.
Reported area is a measured pixel ratio, not the WCAG visual-field threshold. Fine patterns, DOM attribution and red black-point chromaticity are not validated.

Candidate start/end times are relative to the first analyzed decoded frame, not the scenario start. Leading capture delay is reported separately; source and wall-clock timestamps are not interchangeable.
